title: Simpler Commands
description: This plugin makes many commands shorter. By using the /he command, you can see all of the commands.
body:
This is the first of many plugins made by your's truly. This plugin makes the commands in your server shorter. Example, /locate now works with /lo, or /kill is /ki, and more. You can see all of the commands with /he, or looking in the gallery. and this is only the beginning, since I will improve and make more plugins as the time goes.
